districts.name: Willow Quay
districts.customers: Ferry workers, evening walkers and families shop beside the quiet water.

stalls.name: Chestnut Brazier
stalls.habit: Lin saves the warmest paper cone for the last ferry worker.
stalls.hire: Ask Lin to tend the brazier
stalls.gossip: Lin says the ferries ran late, so she kept the coals warm.
stalls.next: Suri brings the Ribbon Cart once ten braziers are roasting.

stalls.name: Ribbon Cart
stalls.habit: Suri ties each bow twice, then lets the breeze try it.
stalls.hire: Ask Suri to take the cart
stalls.gossip: Suri says a loose ribbon found its way home on the breeze.
stalls.next: Tao brings the Soup Kettle once ten ribbon carts are tying.

stalls.name: Soup Kettle
stalls.habit: Tao warms each empty bowl before the soup goes in.
stalls.hire: Ask Tao to tend the kettle
stalls.gossip: Tao says the bowl returned first, and its owner stayed to talk.
stalls.next: Neri brings the Kite Bench once ten kettles are simmering.

stalls.name: Kite Bench
stalls.habit: Neri holds every kite up to the lamplight before tying its tail.
stalls.hire: Ask Neri to take the bench
stalls.gossip: Neri says the smallest kite flew higher than anyone expected.
stalls.next: Asha brings the Flower Barrow once ten kite benches are folding.

stalls.name: Flower Barrow
stalls.habit: Asha turns the flowers toward the water while she fills their jars.
stalls.hire: Ask Asha to take the barrow
stalls.gossip: Asha says someone brought an empty jar back with a thank-you note.
stalls.next: Fen brings the Music Corner once ten flower barrows are wrapping.

stalls.name: Music Corner
stalls.habit: Fen leaves a quiet space between tunes for the ferries to answer.
stalls.hire: Ask Fen to take the corner
stalls.gossip: Fen says a ferry bell joined the tune at just the right moment.
